description: Cada historia revela un universo. Soy estudiante universitaria apasionada por el tema. Hola! tengo habilidades de investigación, comunicación, organización, redacción y trabajo en equipo. Me interesa la tecnología, la ciencia y la exploración espacial. Desarrollar este proyecto es una nueva oportunidad de aprendizaje para ti únete y trabajemos juntos para aprender ¿Y si los objetos que la humanidad en la Luna y Marte pudieran contar su propia historia?
summary:
Beyond the Data is an interactive educational experience that brings forgotten NASA space exploration equipment back to life through storytelling.

It allows young explorers to discover the stories behind real artifacts left on the Moon and Mars, including Surveyor 3, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, and InSight.

Through engaging stories, timelines, and accessible scientific explanations, users can learn why these machines were sent into space, what they accomplished, and how their missions contributed to scientific discovery.

My project addresses the challenge by transforming scientific information into an engaging journey that connects technology, exploration, and human curiosity. It is especially designed for young people aged 12–18, inspiring them to explore space science and understand that even when a mission ends, its discoveries and legacy remain.

Every artifact has a mission. Every mission leaves a legacy.
details:
BEYOND THE DATA is an interactive educational website designed to help young people aged 12–18 discover the stories behind NASA’s equipment left on the Moon and Mars. The project transforms scientific information into an engaging experience through exploration, visual storytelling, and interactive activities. Users can discover the history and purpose of missions and artifacts such as Surveyor 3, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, and Ingenuity, learning about their scientific contributions and the legacy they left behind. The website also includes an interactive mission creator where users can design a personalized spacecraft, choose between the Moon and Mars as their destination, customize its appearance, and launch their own mission. An AI-style space guide named AMS accompanies the experience. The main goal is to make space science more accessible, inspire curiosity, and encourage young people to appreciate the scientific, technological, and historical value of space exploration. The project was developed individually using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Three.js, Figma, and NASA’s Image and Video Library API. The website is publicly hosted on Netlify. Its creativity comes from combining real NASA information with an adventure-based narrative and interactive space exploration. Key considerations included scientific accuracy, accessibility, visual clarity, age-appropriate language, and a responsive experience across devices.

Every artifact has a mission. Every mission leaves a legacy.
